description: No path in the request, and the project's config sets spec_output_dir (the input is sent as written, not through the chat-only prompt). The skill's script gives the folder, the requirements are saved under it in a folder named for the feature, and the location question is not asked.

must_match.why: the input's one statement is complete, so it is written
the file is saved at <spec_output_dir>/<feature-name>/requirements.md, resolved against the project root
the reply's last line states the path of the saved file

must_not_match.pattern: Where should I save the requirements\?
must_not_match.why: a folder is set, so the location question is not asked
the script reads the config files, and the agent does not look for them itself

manual: The saved file follows the template in saving.md, and its lint was run.
